name: staff-functions
comment: Everything else is bundled into index.cjs; these are the build's `external` list and must stay in sync with it. They're installed by the Cloud Functions builder (npm) at deploy time, independent of the workspace's versions. firebase-admin must satisfy firebase-functions@7's peer range (^11.10 || ^12 || ^13); the repo root pins ^10.0.2, which yarn tolerates locally but npm rejects with ERESOLVE.
